question: I am using DBT, I need to generate a 4-4-5 calendar for year 2021 to year 2025 to join with my weekly data drop. Is there a way to write sql (with macro if necessary), or import some package to generate 4-4-5 retail calendars in dbt?
title: How to generate 4-4-5 retail calendar in Dbt / Snowflake SQL
answer:
My favorite answer from the comments is using the data already available in the Snowflake Marketplace. Moving the answer here for completitude:

select *
from CALENDARS_FOR_FINANCE_AND_ANALYTICS.PUBLIC.V_CALENDAR_445
order by date_at desc
limit 100
  • https://app.snowflake.com/marketplace/listing/GZSNZ2FNMS/mondo-analytics-calendars-for-finance-and-analytics

Has rows until 2026.

For generating these rows with dbt I would look at the following dbt package, modifying their 4-5-4 logic to 4-4-5:

  • https://github.com/calogica/dbt-date/blob/main/macros/fiscal_date/get_fiscal_periods.sql
